player_0.content: New plan: I failed because the generated name "FAREFLUX" did not explicitly convey the company's core function of "analyzing" data, only collecting fares. The name sounded like a utility or a payment processor rather than an analytics firm. Next time, I will ensure the name includes a root word related to data, insight, or analysis (such as "DATA", "INSIGHT", "ANALYTICS", "METRIC", or "TRACK") combined with a transportation or fare term, and I will strictly verify that the final output is in all capital letters before submitting.
